purpose: Molecular geometry, harmonic vibration and vertical excitation research; no clinical inference
platform: Linux/WSL CPU, Python 3.12, locked quantum profile

vibrations.minimum_acceptance: no negative projected harmonic frequencies; negative modes require review and reoptimization

limitations: Starting conformers are prescreened by MMFF, not a proof of global coverage
C-PCM is a continuum model, no explicit solvent or crystal packing
Harmonic thermochemistry is RRHO at 1 atm, not automatically solution-standard free energy
Frequency scale 1.0 is an unscaled prediction, not calibrated experimental agreement
Method and basis need benchmark assessment for each endpoint
Conformer-ensemble and experimental comparisons are required before a scientific acceptance claim
C-PCM is an electrostatic continuum model; SMD non-electrostatic CDS terms are not included
This model is distinct from SMD; their results are not pooled or labelled equivalent
Quadrature controls must pass before accepting the model discretization
